paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak of the house of R. Ammi, Sotah (9b), several expositions; Shabbat (62b); and chapter Yesh Noḥalin (116a). Also Rabbah, parashat Naso, chapter 9. In Shabbat (80b): R. Yitzḥak said: the house of R. Ammi said. At the end of chapter HaMappelet: R. Yitzḥak said: R. Ammi said, several statements; once, R. Yitzḥak of the house of R. Ammi said; in Ein Yaakov: R. Ammi said. (See above, Zuti of the house of Rav Pappa.)
